body: Founder: 'continue dragons n shit do the docs first.' Wrote docs2/specs/REDGARDEN_MUD_BRIDGE_SPEC.md, the concrete packet-level layer under today's earlier REDGARDEN_GUI_NORTHSTAR.md, grounded in real code on both sides (protocol.h's actual structs, apps2/mud/main.go's actual cmd* handlers). Reuses REDGARDEN's real HMAC connect-ticket handshake. Maps real packets (ArenaAttackCmd, ArenaCastCmd, ArenaShopBuyCmd) onto real functions (cmdAttack, cmdWS, cmdShopBuy); drops PACKET_ARENA_PICK (no draft in a persistent MMO). Found and named two real gaps: apps2/mud has zero continuous intra-zone movement server-side today (cmdGo only teleports between zones), and ArenaAttackCmd's hero-slot targeting has no equivalent against apps2/mud's string-ID targeting -- both reframe the northstar's own milestone scope. Proposed a MudEvent list to replace REDGARDEN's flat HP-delta visual-effect idiom. UDP port 2324 proposed. Updated REDGARDEN_GUI_NORTHSTAR.md in place, registered in golden-docs-index. GoblinFoxDragon 1b8bbcd, EMILY d1eb4f6.
title: REDGARDEN <-> apps2/mud packet-level bridge spec written
